beats.say: A razor that never stops shaving. And you pay forever.
Option A: a single razor, no blades attached.
Option B: razor plus a starter pack of blades.
Option C: razor, blades, and a subscription service.
First year you get 51 razors and 168 blades. Sounds generous.
Each razor sold creates a customer who must keep buying blades.
In year two sales jump to 90,884 razors and 123,648 blades, proving the model works.
The subscription bundle is the lure; it locks you into the blade market.
A coffee shop sells a grinder alone, a grinder with beans, and a grinder-beans-subscription.
The subscription, priced close to the grinder-beans combo, feels like the smart choice.
If a product bundles consumables, expect ongoing costs. Follow for more.
